description: This file defines command-line interface commands for microphone management, including listing available microphones and setting a default input device, utilizing AVFoundation for device discovery.

classes.name: MicCommand
classes.description: Defines the main microphone command with subcommands for listing and setting devices.

classes.name: MicList
classes.description: Implements the command to list available microphone input devices.

classes.name: MicSet
classes.description: Implements the command to set a specific microphone device as default based on index, with optional configuration loading and saving.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the command's main functionality, either listing devices or updating configuration depending on the command.

methods.name: MicSet.init(parsed:)
methods.description: Initializes MicSet with parsed command-line arguments.

methods.name: MicSet.run
methods.description: Sets the device index in configuration and saves the updated config.
